claim: Break qualifying unbroken 1941 German Army Truppenschluessel (TS) messages from CryptoCellar (g-army-ts-messages.html & 1941-msg-list.html) with >=85% German military word/abbreviation coverage, <=8% Morse-plausible garbles, and >=5 SD over 200 shuffled-ciphertext controls, plus p1 blind garble benchmark, p2, and p3 same-key evidence

Lens 1 (P0072): 08.07.1941 same-day attack on IABZV (48), IASRZ #129 (90), IASRZ #130 (52), and odd-length EHNPZ #123 (87 letters, unbroken on both g-army-ts-messages.html and 1941-msg-list.html) recovers the exact 08.07.1941 5x5 key squares and locates the 1-letter phase shift in EHNPZ

Lens 2 (P0073): Multi-day Shotgun Hill-Climbing + Simulated Annealing breaks additional unmarked TS messages/clusters on g-army-ts-messages.html (04.07.1941, 03.07.1941, 06.07.1941, 25.07.1941, 31.07.1941 VHRNE, and August/September outgoing messages)

Lens 3 (P0074): Blind garble-tolerance benchmark (p1) recovers >=95% of plaintext letters on all 3 period-style German military texts (60-100 letters) enciphered with random 5x5 squares and ~8% Morse-plausible garbles

text: Can we break an unmarked 1941 TS message on g-army-ts-messages.html or pass the p1 blind garble-tolerance benchmark (3 texts of 60-100 chars with ~8% Morse garbles, >=95% recovery)?
Lens 1 (08.07.1941 & Multi-Day Rope Team): Same-day phase-locked clusters on 08.07.1941 (274 chars) and 03.07.1941 (250 chars) with V12/H1/H2/Unmix C Rope Team recover daily 5x5 squares

Lens 2 (p1 Blind Garble-Tolerance Benchmark): Validated C TS solver + V12/H1/H2/Unmix Rope Team + 1941 German military lexicon ungarbler recovers >=95% of plaintext letters on all 3 blind 60-100 letter German military texts with ~8% Morse-plausible garbles

why: 08.07.1941 (384,123 / 1401.9 per char), 03.07.1941 (124 unique chars after stutter dedup), and 04.07.1941 (internal phase shift in Nr.92 + garbles in VZHGZVUULVXKYOGKEK) did not reach >=85% German prose coverage without joint phase-shift breakpoint and garble-correction decoding.

Uncapped T4_COND + Row-Pair Subset Unmixer recovers 194/194 (100.0%) of 14.07.1941 at Sample 811 from a 7-bigram crib, but single 60-100 char messages under 8.4% CT garbles have a true-key raw ceiling of 85.7% (204/238) due to digraphic error amplification and 6.3% single-message blind accuracy due to unicity deficit.

text: Can joint Viterbi phase-shift + 1-letter Morse error-correcting EM inside the 5,120-move Row-Pair Subset Unmixer break 04.07.1941 (682 chars) or 08.07.1941 (274 chars)?

Uncapped T4_COND + V12/H1/H2 + 5,120-move Row-Pair Subset Unmixer recovers 194/194 (100.0%) of 14.07.1941 at Sample 811 from a 7-bigram crib (571,334/571,334) and 540,561/571,334 (94.6%) from blind starts.

why: CONFIRMED_PARTIAL p1 in Run 2026-10-21-0015 (PR #602): 50/50 blind key square recovery and 97.84% greedy / 98.71% Viterbi (>=95% on all 3 messages)
